mode: method development on eight already known archived clouds; not independent confirmation
source: unchanged radius 1/2, carrier 4, g=0; evaluated in units A/e
history: all original nodes t<=-1; H1=P f+(t+1)P g; KG Cauchy closure stated explicitly
spatial_projection: orthogonal L2 projection onto continuous tetrahedral P1 hats on convex hull of original history spatial sites
mesh: scipy Delaunay proposal; exact Fraction positive-chain and convex-boundary certificate; no jitter or replacement sites
integration: waves: analytic exponential simplex moments with bounded real-axis Taylor remainder; compact: fixed longest-edge bisection, exact dyadic geometry and mean hat weights times Arb field-range enclosures
normalization: wave amplitude 1; compact amplitude A/e, the same physical source as v0.10
detector: reuse full certified v0.10 finest-grid transfer balls for both original windows, with matching coordinate hash; do not use transfer midpoints
decision: any uncertified coverage, mesh, solve, resolution, history budget or integration budget gives HOLD; finite upper-bound failure is not a measured error lower bound
